cat > tests/test_export.py <<'EOF'
"""Check file for prefix-search-export. Run after `python export.py build`; locked for the builder."""
import json
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

SRC = json.loads(Path("data/books.json").read_text())
OUT = json.loads(Path("build/search.json").read_text())
FIELDS = {"isbn", "edition", "title", "active", "key"}


def test_schema_and_identity():
    books = OUT["books"]
    assert set(OUT) == {"books"}
    assert all(set(b) == FIELDS for b in books)
    assert len(books) == len(SRC) == 4
    assert len({(b["isbn"], b["edition"]) for b in books}) == 4


def test_titles_and_keys():
    by_id = {(r["isbn"], r["edition"]): r for r in SRC}
    for b in OUT["books"]:
        src = by_id[(b["isbn"], b["edition"])]
        assert b["title"] == src["title"] and b["active"] == src["active"]
        assert b["key"] == src["title"].casefold()
    strasse = [b for b in OUT["books"] if b["title"].startswith("Straße")]
    assert len(strasse) == 2 and all(len(b["key"]) == len(b["title"]) + 1 for b in strasse)


def test_inactive_kept_and_order():
    books = OUT["books"]
    assert any(not b["active"] for b in books)
    assert books == sorted(books, key=lambda b: (b["title"], b["isbn"], b["edition"]))


def _search(prefix):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "export.py", "search", prefix],
                       capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
    return [(b["isbn"], b["edition"]) for b in json.loads(p.stdout)["books"]]


def test_prefix_search():
    assert len(_search("strasse")) == 2
    assert len(_search("STRAß A")) == 2
    assert _search("app") == [("9780000000035", "paper")]
    assert _search("Z") == [("9780000000028", "paper")]
    assert _search("zz") == []
EOF
